items.summary: Hong Kong police are searching for a motorist who rammed through a roadblock in Tsim Sha Tsui in the early hours of Tuesday, hitting four taxis and injuring one of the cabbies before fleeing.

items.title: U.S. federal review faults leadership failures in Grand Canyon fire that destroyed lodge
items.summary: Leadership failures along with a lack of preparedness and poor communication were the driving factors of a wildfire that destroyed a historic lodge.

items.title: Police searching for suspect after ‘large quantity’ of iPads stolen from Oakville school
items.summary: Police in Halton Region are asking for the public’s help after a “large quantity” of iPads were stolen from a school in Oakville last month.
